moments.title: Strictly's Glitterball Return
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its highly anticipated launch show this Saturday, revealing the celebrity-professional pairings for 2026.

angles.name: Launch Show Buzz
angles.copy: The Glitterball is back! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is this Saturday, revealing who's dancing with who. Who are you rooting for already?

angles.name: New Hosts Debut
angles.copy: New era for Strictly! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe make their hosting debut this Saturday for the launch. Big shoes to fill!

moments.title: Bake Off Tent Reopens
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series on Tuesday, September 22nd, with new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood, Alison Hammond, and Noel Fielding.

angles.name: Bake Off Is Back
angles.copy: Get your aprons ready! The Great British Bake Off is back this Tuesday, September 22nd, for a brand new series. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: Big news in the Bake Off tent! Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a new judge this season. Ready for some delicious critiques!

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart Topper
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' has climbed to number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of September 10-16, 2026.

angles.name: New No.1
angles.copy: New UK No.1! Sienna Spiro takes the top spot with 'Great Expectation' this week. What's your favourite track in the Top 40?

angles.name: Chart Movers
angles.copy: Miley Cyrus is a new entry with 'Bass Persuades' and Dua Lipa's 'Training Season' re-enters the Top 10. Big moves on this week's Official Singles Chart!

moments.title: Jacqueline Bisset Turns 82
moments.blurb: British actress Jacqueline Bisset, known for films like 'The Deep' and 'Casino Royale', celebrates her 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jacqueline Bisset
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 82nd Birthday to the iconic British actress Jacqueline Bisset! What's your favourite of her films?

moments.title: Niall Horan Turns 33
moments.blurb: Irish singer-songwriter and former One Direction member Niall Horan celebrates his 33rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Niall
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the brilliant Niall Horan! What's your favourite solo track from the former One Direction star?

moments.title: Fiona Apple Turns 49
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American singer-songwriter Fiona Apple, known for her distinctive style, celebrates her 49th birthday today.

angles.name: Fiona Apple's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 49th Birthday to the incredible Fiona Apple! Her unique sound has influenced so many. What's your go-to Fiona track?

moments.title: Peter Cetera Turns 82
moments.blurb: Lead singer of the band Chicago and successful solo artist, Peter Cetera, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Peter Cetera
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 82nd Birthday to Peter Cetera! From Chicago classics to his solo hits, what's your favourite Peter Cetera song?

moments.title: Nas Turns 53
moments.blurb: Influential American rapper and record producer Nas, known for his seminal album 'Illmatic', celebrates his 53rd birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Nas
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the legendary Nas turns 53! What's your favourite track from one of hip-hop's greatest? #Nas

moments.title: Nick Jonas Turns 33
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter and actor Nick Jonas, known for the Jonas Brothers and his solo work, celebrates his 33rd birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Nick Jonas Birthday
angles.copy: Wednesday marks Nick Jonas's 33rd birthday! What's your favourite Jonas Brothers hit or Nick solo anthem?

moments.title: Richard Marx Turns 63
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Richard Marx, famous for 80s and 90s power ballads, celebrates his 63rd birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Richard Marx Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to Richard Marx on Wednesday! 'Right Here Waiting' or 'Hazard' – which classic is your favourite?

moments.title: Flo Rida Turns 47
moments.blurb: American rapper Flo Rida, known for global hits like 'Low' and 'Club Can't Handle Me', celebrates his 47th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Flo Rida's Birthday
angles.copy: Wednesday is Flo Rida's 47th Birthday! Get ready to party like it's 'Low' or 'Club Can't Handle Me'. What's your favourite banger?

moments.title: Frankie Avalon Turns 86
moments.blurb: Teen idol, singer, and actor Frankie Avalon, famous for hits like 'Venus' and his 'Beach Party' films, celebrates his 86th birthday this Friday.

angles.name: Frankie Avalon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 86th Birthday to the original teen idol Frankie Avalon this Friday! 'Venus' is still a classic. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Skepta Turns 44
moments.blurb: Grime pioneer and Mercury Prize winner Skepta, a hugely influential figure in British music, celebrates his 44th birthday this Saturday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Skepta
angles.copy: This Saturday, the one and only Skepta turns 44! Celebrate the grime legend with your favourite track. #Skepta

moments.title: Heritage Open Days Continue
moments.blurb: Heritage Open Days, offering thousands of free events and access to historic sites across England, continue until September 20th.

angles.name: Explore Hidden Gems
angles.copy: Discover England's hidden history for free! Heritage Open Days run until September 20th, with thousands of events across the country. What will you explore?

moments.title: London Festivals Ongoing
moments.blurb: London's Open House Festival and London Design Festival are both running until September 20th, celebrating the city's architecture and creativity.

angles.name: London Unlocked
angles.copy: Explore London's iconic buildings and incredible design for free! Open House Festival and London Design Festival are both on until Sept 20th.

moments.title: Abergavenny Food Festival
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Abergavenny Food Festival, featuring tastings, chef demos, and workshops, takes place this weekend, September 19-20.

angles.name: Foodie Weekend in Wales
angles.copy: Calling all foodies! The Abergavenny Food Festival is on this weekend, Sept 19-20, with delicious tastings and chef demos. Who's heading there?

moments.title: Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival Starts
moments.blurb: Tulleys Farm in West Sussex launches its popular Pumpkin Festival this Saturday, running until October 31st, with over a million pumpkins.

angles.name: Pumpkin Picking Season
angles.copy: Get ready for pumpkin spice and everything nice! Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival kicks off this Saturday in West Sussex. Time to pick your perfect pumpkin!
